title: RBI invites comments on the draft “Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Eleventh Amendment Directions, 2026”
description: The Reserve Bank of India has today released the draft Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Eleventh Amendment Directions, 2026, which propose to amend ‘Chapter VII: Leverage Ratio framework’ of the Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Directions, 2025.
